page.title: System Configs
page.unsaved_content: You have unsaved changes. Are you sure to leave?
page.select_group: Please select a config group from the left

group_desc.platform_domain: Tenant domain suffix and custom-domain verification settings
group_desc.platform_ssl: ACME certificate issuance, DNS provider, renewal policy
group_desc.platform_ai_toolkit: Toolkit security policies and resource limits
group_desc.tenant_general: Login security, password policy, session settings
group_desc.tenant_registration: User registration flow, default role, privacy policy and terms settings
group_desc.tenant_features: Notifications, profile editing, file upload and other member feature toggles

platform_desc.site_name: Displayed in browser title bar and header
platform_desc.acme_account_email: Used for Let's Encrypt account registration and certificate expiry notifications
platform_desc.acme_use_staging: ON = request from staging server (not browser-trusted, relaxed rate limits, for dev); OFF = request from production server (trusted certs, 5 per domain per week). Both require DNS validation, 90-day, auto-renewed
platform_desc.acme_directory_url: Let's Encrypt production ACME directory URL
platform_desc.acme_staging_url: Let's Encrypt staging ACME directory URL
platform_desc.ssl_private_key_encryption_key: Fernet key for encrypting stored SSL private keys
platform_desc.ssl_auto_renew_days: Days before expiry to trigger automatic renewal
platform_desc.ssl_allow_custom_cert: Whether to allow tenants to upload custom SSL certificates
platform_desc.dns_provider: Production automation currently supports only Cloudflare DNS-01; manual mode is for development/debug only
platform_desc.dns_cloudflare_api_token: Cloudflare API Token (requires Zone.DNS edit permission)

validation.min_length: Length must be at least {min} characters

tenant_desc.tenant_logo: Logo displayed in tenant admin panel
tenant_desc.tenant_logo_dark: Preferred tenant logo when dark theme is active
tenant_desc.tenant_icp: Tenant-specific filing number; falls back to the platform default when empty
